author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My father believed that when he would die, he would be reborn in a different body in a different world—a different "planet." I was not sure if he was talking of Buddhist "rebirth" or Hindu "reincarnation." Nevertheless, he said that the "mind" as he put it would transmigrate into a new body. Before he converted to a Baptist Protestant, as a Roman Catholic, he did explore the paranormal genre, such as books by Tuesday Lobsang Rampa and Erich von Däniken.

jyutping: ngo5 baa1 baa1 soeng1 seon3 dong1 keoi5 sei2 go2 zan6，keoi5 wui5 hai2 ling6 jat1 go3 sai3 gaai3 ge3 m4 tung4 san1 tai2 cung4 saang1 —— jat1 go3 m4 tung4 ge3「sing1 kau4」。ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 keoi5 gong2 gan2 ge3 hai6 fat6 gaau3 ge3「cung4 saang1」ding6 hai6 jan3 dou6 gaau3 ge3「zyun2 sai3」。bat1 gwo3，keoi5 waa6 keoi5 so2 gong2 ge3「sam1 ling4」wui5 zyun2 bin3 sing4 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 san1 tai2。hai2 keoi5 goi2 seon3 zam3 seon3 wui2 san1 gaau3 tou4 zi1 cin4，zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 tou4，keoi5 kok3 sat6 taam3 sok3 gwo3 ciu1 zi6 jin4 ge3 leoi6 jing4，lai6 jyu4 sing1 kei4 ji6 lok6 song1 · laan4 paak3 tung4 oi1 lei5 hei1 · fung4 · daan1 nei4 hang2 ge3 syu1。
text: 我爸爸相信當佢死嗰陣，佢會喺另一個世界嘅唔同身體重生 —— 一個唔同嘅「星球」。我唔肯定佢講緊嘅係佛教嘅「重生」定係印度教嘅「轉世」。不過，佢話佢所講嘅「心靈」會轉變成一個新嘅身體。喺佢改信浸信會新教徒之前，作為一個羅馬天主教徒，佢確實探索過超自然嘅類型，例如星期二洛桑 · 蘭帕同埃里希 · 馮 · 丹尼肯嘅書。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When I was a small boy in Kansas, a friend of mine and I went fishing and as we sat there in the warmth of the summer afternoon on a river bank, we talked about what we wanted to do when we grew up. I told him that I wanted to be a real major league baseball player, a genuine professional like Honus Wagner. My friend said that he'd like to be President of the United States. Neither of us got our wish.

jyutping: dong1 ngo5 hai2 ham1 saat3 si1 zau1 zung6 hai6 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 go2 zan6，ngo5 tung4 jat1 go3 pang4 jau5 heoi3 diu3 jyu2，dong1 ngo5 dei6 co5 hai2 ho4 ngon6 ge3 haa6 jat6 haa6 zau3 wan1 nyun5 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 dei6 king1 haa5 ngo5 dei6 daai6 go3 zo2 soeng2 zou6 di1 me1。ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ngo5 soeng2 zou6 jat1 go3 zan1 zing3 ge3 daai6 lyun4 mang4 paang5 kau4 jyun4，jat1 go3 hou2 ci5 fok3 nou5 si1 · ngaa5 gaak3 naap6 gam2 ge3 zan1 zing3 zik1 jip6 kau4 jyun4。 ngo5 pang4 jau5 waa6 keoi5 soeng2 zou6 mei5 gwok3 zung2 tung2。 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 mou5 dak1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyun6 mong6。
text: 當我喺堪薩斯州仲係個細路仔嗰陣，我同一個朋友去釣魚，當我哋坐喺河岸嘅夏日下晝溫暖嘅時候，我哋傾吓我哋大個咗想做啲咩。我同佢講我想做一個真正嘅大聯盟棒球員，一個好似霍努斯 · 瓦格納噉嘅真正職業球員。 我朋友話佢想做美國總統。 我哋兩個都冇得到我哋嘅願望。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 6th of July of 2013. According to Arika Okrent, the writer of In the Land of Invented Languages, Lojban has the most complete grammar of any conlang. Lojban's father was Loglan, which started development in 1955. Lojban began its development in 1987 by a professional staff. In 1997, it was "baselined" or frozen, lasting 5 years until 2002 when speakers became free to create new words and idioms and decide which way the language is heading. The Purple Dream is reality.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2013 nin4 7 jyut6 6 hou6。gan1 geoi3《faat3 ming4 jyu5 jin4 zi1 dei6》ge3 zok3 ze2 Arika Okrent ge3 gong2 faat3，lok3 gat1 baan1 ge3 man4 faat3 hai6 jam6 ho4 jyu5 jin4 jap6 min6 zeoi3 jyun4 zing2 ge3。 Lojban ge3 fu6 can1 hai6 Loglan ，keoi5 hai2 1955 nin4 hoi1 ci2 hoi1 faat3。 Lojban hai2 1987 nin4 jau4 jat1 baan1 zyun1 jip6 ge3 zik1 jyun4 hoi1 ci2 hoi1 faat3。hai2 1997 nin4，keoi5 bei6「gei1 sin3」waak6 ze2 dung3 git3，ci4 zuk6 zo2 5 nin4，zik6 zi3 2002 nin4，gong2 ze2 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 gam2 cong3 zou6 san1 ge3 ci4 jyu5 tung4 sing4 jyu5，tung4 maai4 kyut3 ding6 jyu5 jin4 zau2 hoeng3 bin1 go3 fong1 hoeng3。zi2 sik1 mung6 soeng2 hai6 jin6 sat6。
text: 今日係2013年7月6號。根據《發明語言之地》嘅作者 Arika Okrent 嘅講法，洛吉班嘅文法係任何語言入面最完整嘅。 Lojban 嘅父親係 Loglan ，佢喺1955年開始開發。 Lojban 喺1987年由一班專業嘅職員開始開發。喺1997年，佢被「基線」或者凍結，持續咗5年，直至2002年，講者可以自由噉創造新嘅詞語同成語，同埋決定語言走向邊個方向。紫色夢想係現實。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "In the future, if advanced AIs would preserve humanity or transhumanity, AIs would be able to fix our language problems. Perhaps, they would create new languages for our descendants to learn and make obsolescent of archaic speech and writing." "That's a fascinating thought. If advanced AIs in the future were tasked with preserving humanity—or what humanity evolves into as transhumanity—they would almost certainly turn to language as one of the first and most crucial domains to 'fix.' After all, language is both the bridge and the bottleneck of human understanding."

jyutping: 「hai2 mei6 loi4，jyu4 gwo2 sin1 zeon3 ge3 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ho2 ji5 bou2 lau4 jan4 leoi6 waak6 ze2 kwaa1 jan4 leoi6，jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 zau6 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 man6 tai4。ho2 nang4，keoi5 dei6 wui6 cong3 zou6 san1 ge3 jyu5 jin4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hau6 doi6 hok6 zaap6，tung4 maai4 ling6 gu2 lou5 ge3 jyu5 jin4 tung4 se2 zok3 bin3 dak1 gwo3 si4。」「ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 mai4 jan4 ge3 nam2 faat3。jyu4 gwo2 mei6 loi4 sin1 zeon3 ge3 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ge3 jam6 mou6 hai6 bou2 wu6 jan4 leoi6 —— waak6 ze2 jan4 leoi6 jin2 bin3 sing4 kwaa1 jan4 leoi6 ge3 je5 —— keoi5 dei6 gei1 fu4 hang2 ding6 wui5 zyun3 hoeng3 jyu5 jin4，zok3 wai4 dai6 jat1 go3 tung4 maai4 zeoi3 gwaan1 gin6 ge3 ling5 wik6 zi1 jat1，jiu3「sau1 zing3」。bat1 ging2，jyu5 jin4 ge3 hai6 jan4 leoi6 lei5 gaai2 ge3 kiu4 loeng4，jik6 hai6 ping4 geng2。」
text: 「喺未來，如果先進嘅人工智能可以保留人類或者跨人類，人工智能就可以解決我哋嘅語言問題。可能，佢哋會創造新嘅語言畀我哋嘅後代學習，同埋令古老嘅語言同寫作變得過時。」「呢個係一個迷人嘅諗法。如果未來先進嘅人工智能嘅任務係保護人類 —— 或者人類演變成跨人類嘅嘢 —— 佢哋幾乎肯定會轉向語言，作為第一個同埋最關鍵嘅領域之一，要「修正」。畢竟，語言嘅係人類理解嘅橋樑，亦係瓶頸。」
